name: blea
description: Agent-first Bluetooth Low Energy diagnostics and guarded automation.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose and automate Bluetooth Low Energy devices.
interface.longDescription: BLEA gives agents a safe local BLE workflow: diagnose the adapter, select devices deterministically, inspect GATT services, read and subscribe, and perform explicitly authorized writes.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose my Bluetooth adapter and scan for nearby BLE devices.
Inspect this BLE device and explain its readable characteristics.
Safely subscribe to notifications from this BLE characteristic.
